subject: Mutual Action Plan — success checkpoints, exit evidence, and acceptance runbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Mendez <alyssa.m@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + proposed acceptance runbook

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our plan, attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (sheet view + PDF) that lays out the evaluation checkpoints, explicit exit gates, and the acceptance tests you asked for. High-level goals for this MAP:

- Make progress to a production decision within 6 weeks.
- Validate accuracy and latency requirements against a small production-like sample (10k daily inference volume) with telemetry hooks.
- Agree on evidence artifacts for procurement to close (SLA language, throughput tests, and audit log sample).

Key dates I propose (all negotiable):
- Week 1 (Dec 9–15): infra/setup + sample data ingest; API keys and test account provisioned by Redwood.
- Week 2 (Dec 16–22): smoke performance run (latency distribution, token-cost projection, error-rate).
- Week 3 (Dec 23–29): functional acceptance (accuracy/recall/edge-case sampling + response integrity).
- Week 4 (Dec 30–Jan 5): security evidence handoff + procurement artifacts for signature.

I've put named owners in the MAP and a short acceptance checklist (see attached). A few items to flag for your team to confirm:
1) Target latency SLO for conversational flows (p50/p95) — currently set to 250ms/800ms for 8k average sequence.
2) Data retention window for logs (we included a 30-day sample; if you need longer we can attach a SOC2-friendly redaction plan).
3) Success threshold for the evaluation: 85% match to your current baseline on the curated prompt set + no critical safety regressions.

Attachment: [Veridian_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)] [eval-acceptance-checklist.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]

If that looks good, can you confirm procurement contacts and any compliance docs we should include in the Week 4 handoff? I can loop in Marissa for the acceptance tests and Grace for rollout operationalization.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[karthik@redwoodinference.com]

---
From: Alyssa Mendez <alyssa.m@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Veridian Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 09:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP draft + proposed acceptance runbook

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed MAP. A few clarifications from our side:

- The timeline looks reasonable but we need the Week 2 performance run to include a head-to-head against our current provider for the same prompt set. Can Redwood run parallel calls and export raw latencies/token counts?
- For the success threshold, 85% on recall is fine as an initial gate, but we need a secondary check for hallucination rate on a 200-sample set (we can provide).
- Procurement notes: purchase order and standard BAAs are handled by procurement@veridianhealth.com. For Week 4, Procurement will want sample audit logs (anonymized) and a simple KMS flow diagram.

Also, can you add a rollback/escape hatch clause in the MAP that defines the conditions under which we pause a rollout (e.g., avg p95 >1.2s or spike in error rate >3% sustained for 15 minutes)?

Alyssa
Head of Product Integrations — Veridian Health
alyssa.m@veridianhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Mendez <alyssa.m@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + proposed acceptance runbook

Alyssa, Karthik —

Appreciate the flags. I updated the acceptance checklist and added explicit test vectors and measurement methods. Summary of the changes I pushed into Veridian_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (tab: AcceptanceTests):

- Performance test plan: parallel-run harness that will execute each request against both vendors and capture p50/p95/99, token counts, and endpoint error codes. Owner: marissa_cole.
- Accuracy/recall tests: canonical prompt set + Veridian-supplied 200-sample hallucination set. Measurement: micro-F1 + a human review column for edge cases. Owner: Veridian review + Redwood verification.
- Safety checks: output filters and a regression harness that flags any responses containing protected-health-identifiers or policy violations.
- Evidence artifacts for procurement: 30-day anonymized audit log export (CSV), sample KMS flow image, and a signed concurrency/throughput test report.

Escape hatch language (proposed):
- Pause condition: sustained p95 latency > 1.2s OR sustained 15-min error-rate >3% OR >5 safety regressions in a rolling 48-hour window.
- Remediation window: Redwood will triage and provide a mitigation plan within 4 business hours; rollback within 24 hours if mitigation is not acceptable.

I added an 'owner' column and calendar slots for each test so we can track readiness. Please review the AcceptanceTests tab and tell me if I missed anything operationally.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: [eval-acceptance-checklist.pdf (updated) (pdf, 240KB)]

Alyssa / Procurement —

Thanks — and great feedback. Per Marissa's updates, we've:
- Added the parallel-run harness and telemetry export (raw CSVs of latencies + tokens will be provided).
- Added the hallucination 200-sample review and a human-review signoff column.
- Added the proposed rollback/escape hatch language and remediation windows.

Next steps:
1) Veridian to drop the 200-sample hallucination set into the Drive folder by EOD Monday (Dec 15).
2) Redwood to schedule the parallel performance run for Dec 17–18 (we'll confirm exact windows once we get the sample set).
3) Procurement: once the Week 2 run is complete and the Week 3 functional tests hit the thresholds, we'll prepare the procurement package for Week 4 handoff.

If procurement needs a shorter artifact list to start the PO, we can provide a trimmed 'starter' evidence packet (PO-friendly) while the full audit artifacts are gathered.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the MAP owners and timeline (link below). If everyone's aligned I can treat the attached MAP as the source-of-truth and lock edits to the owners column.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running next week.

Best,
